lines.en: Stroll through the woods, enjoying the peace.
Move slowly, cute and cuddly.
Step on fallen leaves, lightly.
Walk by the stream, feeling cool.
Cross the grass, leaving footprints.
Move slowly under the tree shade.
Stroll in the jungle, seeking food.
Leap lightly, move gracefully.
Stroll leisurely in the bamboo forest.
Step on the broken stones, steady footsteps.
It trails its owner through the bamboo shadows.
The sword on its back sways with each step.
Lazily lie under the tree.
Cute and lazy, self-satisfied.
Relax, munching bamboo leaves.
Relax, enjoying the sunshine.
Cute and dozing off.
Lazily bask in the sun.
Relax, roll over.
Lazily bask in the sun.
Doze off, enjoying the peace.
It dozes off hugging a bamboo stalk.
Spot the player, curiously looking around.
Watch the player closely, wary of them.
Watch the player, ready to counterattack.
I size you up, holding bamboo.
Gently watch the player.
Intimidate the player with a gaze.
My claws grip the ground.
Master, I'm right behind you.
Stare intently at the player.
Be wary of the player, ready to counterattack.
It tilts its head as if waiting for an order.
It stares at the blade at your hip.
It relaxes once it knows it is you.
It points a paw deeper into the bamboo.
I'm hurt, master, please help me!
Master, I'm hurt, come quick!

lines.zh: 我的竹剑，还能再挥两下。
lines.en: My bamboo sword can swing twice more.
Master, I need you!
Save me, master!
The fur on my back bristles.
My fang knocks against stone.
I'm hurt, master!
My bamboo blade drops beside me.
Blood stains the white fur on its chest.
Delicious treat, come to me!
Bamboo is my delicacy!
Master, give me food!
This bamboo forest is my food source!
Follow me, master!
Evil spirits near, I'll protect you!
Follow me, to a safe place!
Don't be afraid, I'll protect you!
Master, let's go home!
Evil spirits coming, get ready!
Watch out, I have sword skills!
Evil spirits, away from me!
My sword skills scare away evil!
Evil spirits, I'll retaliate!
Master, evil spirits coming!
Evil spirit, I'll teach you a lesson!
My furry shoulder shoves you aside.
Evil spirits too close, watch out!
Evil spirits, let's fight!
Evil spirits, I'll protect you!

lines.zh: 我把最嫩的竹笋推过去。
lines.en: I push the tenderest shoot over.
Find a panda, for mating!
Panda, let's mate!
I hold a blade, and I still love bamboo.
Mating is a panda's duty!
Panda, let's mate!
Panda, mating time!
Panda, let's reproduce!
Panda, reproduce!
It wants a mate to guard the grove with.

lines.zh: 啃着竹子，憨态可掬地站起身来。
lines.en: Chomping bamboo, it stands up playfully.

lines.zh: 摇晃着身子，好奇地看着你。
lines.en: Shaking its body, curiously staring at you.
Snuggling your hand, seeking petting.

lines.zh: 用小爪子轻拍你，表示友好。
lines.en: Tapping you gently with its tiny paws.

lines.zh: 舔了舔嘴唇，期待着食物。
lines.en: Licking its lips, expecting food.

lines.zh: 倚在你身旁，安心地打了个盹。
lines.en: Resting beside you, dozing off.

lines.zh: 轻嗅空气，对主人充满信任。
lines.en: Sniffing the air, trusting its owner.

lines.zh: 好奇地打量着你的装备。
lines.en: Curiously inspecting your equipment.

lines.zh: 用鼻子轻触你，请求陪伴。
lines.en: Sniffing you gently, requesting companionship.

lines.zh: 憨笑地看着你，眼神中满是友好。
lines.en: Smiling at you, its eyes full of friendliness.

lines.zh: 发现恶鬼，低吼着警告你。
lines.en: Discovering a ghoul, growling to warn you.

lines.zh: 目光锐利，锁定目标恶鬼。
lines.en: Sharp eyes, locking onto a ghoul.
Watching carefully, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 鼻子嗅来嗅去，锁定恶鬼位置。
lines.en: Sniffing around, pinpointing the ghoul.

lines.zh: 双目圆睁，发出警告低吼。
lines.en: Wide eyes, giving a warning growl.
Ears up, focusing.
Cold eyes, ready to fight.

lines.zh: 嗅到了敌人的气味，紧张地盯着。
lines.en: Smelling danger, tensely staring.

lines.zh: 发出低沉警告声，警告恶鬼靠近。
lines.en: Low warning growl, alerting the ghoul.

lines.zh: 盯着恶鬼，准备一击毙命。
lines.en: Fixing the ghoul with a deadly stare.
Its nose twitches; it smells a demon.
A paw is already on the hilt.
It steps in front of its owner.
Its growl sets the bamboo leaves shaking.

lines.zh: 它朝鬼的方向压低身子
lines.en: It crouches toward the demon.

lines.zh: 用剑指向恶鬼，准备攻击。
lines.en: Pointing the sword at the ghoul, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 凝视恶鬼，发出震耳低吼。
lines.en: Staring at the ghoul, giving a thunderous growl.

lines.zh: 瞄准恶鬼，准备一剑毙命。
lines.en: Aiming at the ghoul, ready to deliver the killing blow.

lines.zh: 轻巧地跃起，剑刃划过恶鬼。
lines.en: Leaping, slicing through the ghoul.

lines.zh: 挥剑砍向恶鬼，发出呼啸声。
lines.en: Swinging the sword at the ghoul, creating a whoosh sound.

lines.zh: 用剑猛击恶鬼，发出沉重打击声。
lines.en: Striking the ghoul with the sword, creating a heavy strike sound.

lines.zh: 挥剑斩向恶鬼，发出断竹声。
lines.en: Swinging the sword at the ghoul, creating a snapping sound.
Swinging the sword with force, the ghoul cries out in pain.
A single strike, the ghoul falls to the ground.

lines.zh: 剑刃刺穿恶鬼，发出撕裂声。
lines.en: The sword pierces the ghoul, creating a ripping sound.
Beast Breathing: it drops low.
It counts the demon's breathing.
On four legs, blade level with its jaws.
It circles to the demon's flank.
The bamboo rustles; it has moved.
The blade tip points at the demon's throat.
It waits for the demon to move first.
Its breathing deepens like a drum.
It keeps its owner behind it.
Only a pair of eyes is left in the bamboo.
Paw attack!
Swing sword!
Hard hit!
I pin the demon's blade with my paw.
Owner attacked!
Evil keep back!

lines.zh: 熊猫剑士，听主人一句就够。
lines.en: One word from my master is enough for this panda swordsman.
Sword dance!
Sword slash!
Bite enemy!
One paw crushes the demon's shoulder.
The blade sweeps low across the ground.
It bites down on the demon's wrist.
Beast Breathing: one cut, straight through.
A paw drives the demon into the dirt.
It rolls and splits the demon at the waist.
The back of the blade breaks the demon's fangs.
It shoulders aside the demon lunging at its owner.
Egg hatches!
Panda ally!
Tame panda!
I tumble out of the bamboo grove.
Panda appears!
Panda ally here!
Protect my home!
Beast Breathing. I guard my master.
Panda shows!
Panda joins!
The egg cracks and a panda peeks out.
It tumbles out of the bamboo thicket.
A taming rope still hangs at its neck.
It stands tall, awaiting your order.
My fur is scorched, master!

lines.zh: 毛这么厚，摔下来还是疼。
lines.en: Thick as my fur is, that fall still hurt.
It's cold, it's cold!
The blast threw me; my head spins!
Something is stuck in my back!
A patch of my fur is singed.
The bamboo has lost its taste.
Lightning hit me!

lines.zh: 兽之呼吸，爪子抓不住虚空。
lines.en: Beast Breathing, but claws find no hold.
